title: When restlessness keeps scattering the heart in the day as it is
issueStatement: Movement is increasing, but clarity is not. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru answers wandering with saint company, listening, and honest stillness. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Choose better placement before choosing more movement.
actionPrompt: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
